question: For each match, considering every innings, please combine runs from both batsman scored and extra runs for each over, then identify the single over with the highest total runs, retrieve the bowler for that over from the ball by ball table, and calculate the average of these highest over totals across all matches, ensuring that all runs and bowler details are accurately reflected.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, 
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_batsman_runs,
           SUM(er.extra_runs) as total_extra_runs,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id 
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id ASC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
),
highest_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, total_runs
    FROM ranked_overs
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT SUM(total_runs) as sum_of_max, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(total_runs) / COUNT(*) as avg
FROM highest_overs
